acceptanceCriteria: Classify the outside-sandbox snapshot failure using exact process observation and load evidence, preserving unknowns.
Retain an actionable diagnostic and regression or explicit platform limit; do not weaken cleanup admission or mask true survivors.
body: Observed 2026-10-01: stock OpenCode 2.0.21, adapter candidate 0.7.7, Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build163, Go1.27.1 darwin/arm64. An escalated (outside sandbox) exact-tuple qualification failed during timing campaign with observed command cleanup incomplete: descendant snapshot unavailable, 309 observed process identities, absent=false. Native campaign cleanup itself was absent=true, no failures. The observed parent was absent on later inspection. The next run on final immutable ae3d07d5256786b5d8c43179e469741f794ccce3 passed all checks, including interruption cleanup. This is suspected tooling/process-observation friction, not proof of a surviving process or broken adapter. Retain failed evidence /private/tmp/corvint-opencode-quiet-context/repo-qualification/qualification-152419482 and passing report qualification-3080314096/report.json. V1-0568 covers sandbox-only update checks; V1-0534 covered natural-exit races and was already completed. Neither exactly covers this outside-sandbox unavailable snapshot. No cleanup/qualification check was bypassed.

completion.reason: Manual disposition: the work was done outside a native attempt and merged as beamfall/corvint PR 440 (merge commit e5d96823cf39ba42bb4e8c480d48e83fce54d7e5, GitHub issue 435). Classification: the descendant observer treated one unavailable process snapshot as a cleanup failure; internal/procgroup now retries unavailable snapshots within a bounded settle window, still fails on persistent unavailability, on a blind interval beyond the bound and on any observed survivor, and reports missed snapshots as a limitation. Regression: TestObservedDescendantSnapshotLossIsRetried (four AHI-032 subtests); race tests passed for procgroup, opencodequalification, lspstdio and testacceptance; one live tools/qualify-opencode run passed at f6523547 before the review repairs and was not rerun after them; independent review findings repaired; 14 PR checks passed. Unknowns preserved: the original outside-sandbox loss was not reproduced naturally, so the load cause is inferred; make gate NOT_RUN. Evidence is the sha256 of the sealed change evidence .corvint/changes/0d9f960f91e11109f42eec9018890b0ca72dce24.cem.json on origin/main; build log docs/build-log/2026-10-01-descendant-snapshot-retry.md. Native claim/submit/complete was not used: a WHOLE_REPOSITORY attempt on V1-0632 is live and the primary checkout main does not contain the merge commit. No gate was failed or bypassed; the ticket requires none.

title: Native OpenCode qualification loses a cleanup snapshot outside the desktop sandbox
